title: Evaluate publishing no_std crates to crates.io
description:
Several LICHEN Rust crates fill gaps in the crates.io ecosystem for no_std/embedded targets. Evaluate extracting and publishing them as standalone crates.

**Candidates:**

| Internal | Proposed Name | Gap Filled | Lines |
|----------|--------------|------------|-------|
| lichen-link/schnorr | `schnorr48` | Only truncated-challenge Ed25519 Schnorr (48B vs 64B) | ~600 |
| lichen-oscore | `oscore` | Only pure-Rust no_std OSCORE (RFC 8613) | ~1500 |
| lichen-kiss/framing | `kiss-framing` | Only no_std KISS TNC framing | ~1400 |
| lichen-senml | `senml-cbor` | Only no_std SenML-CBOR (RFC 8428) | ~1300 |
| lichen-ipv6 | `ipv6-headers` | Minimal IPv6/ICMPv6/UDP parsing (not full stack) | ~1200 |

**Why not use existing crates:**
- `liboscore`: requires C FFI, breaks embedded cross-compilation
- `kiss-tnc`: requires tokio (std)
- `sindit-senml`: requires std (serde_json, chrono, regex)
- `schnorrkel`: uses Ristretto, not Ed25519; 64-byte sigs

**Work per crate:**
1. Extract from lichen-* with minimal dependencies
2. Remove LICHEN-specific imports (use own error types)
3. Add comprehensive docs and examples
4. Security review (especially schnorr48)
5. Choose license (currently GPL-3.0, consider dual MIT/Apache-2.0)
6. Publish to crates.io
acceptance_criteria: Decision made per crate: publish, defer, or keep internal. Published crates have docs, tests, and are on crates.io.
notes: Licensing: As original authors, can relicense extracted crates to MIT/Apache-2.0 for crates.io. LICHEN itself stays GPL-3.0.
close_reason: Published 5 crates to crates.io: schnorr48, oscore, kiss-framing, senml-cbor, ipv6-headers. Skipped SCHC (incomplete RFC 8724 implementation - only ACK-on-Error mode, missing No-Ack/Ack-Always modes).
